$comment: 🔮️ References of the repo identity module. Grapheme segmentation is a Unicode standard, so it is judged by a standards implementation shipped with the runtime; the compose-id and artifact-reference codecs are this repository's own conventions and are recorded as having no reference.

oracles.rationale: UAX #29 extended grapheme cluster segmentation, implemented by the ICU data the JavaScript runtime ships, decides where the leading emoji grapheme of a string ends. The owned rune scanner in this module reimplements that boundary by hand and must not be allowed to agree with itself about zero-width joiner sequences, keycaps, regional-indicator pairs, skin-tone modifiers and variation selectors.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: The entity-emoji vocabulary, the presentation-selector normalisation for the text-default code points, the artifact reference prefixes and the goal and contributor compose-id formats are this repository's own conventions, defined by `🧬️schema/🔣️entity-emojis.json`. Identifier generation is judged by shape and by reproducibility under an injected seed, not by a reference, because a random identifier has no correct value. Confidence comes from the schema-driven specification vectors plus two independently written implementations reading the same table.
